obligations.summary: Providers of general-purpose AI models must supply information and provide access to their model (via APIs, source code, or other technical means) when the AI Office or Commission requests it for compliance assessment or systemic risk investigation.
exceptions: Access request must state legal basis, purpose, reasons, and the period within which access is to be provided

obligations.summary: Legal representatives of providers that are legal persons, companies, or firms without legal personality must provide the requested model access on behalf of the provider when the Commission or AI Office requires it.

The Commission must adopt implementing acts setting out detailed arrangements and conditions for evaluations, including procedures for involving and selecting independent experts, in accordance with the examination procedure.

Providers of general-purpose AI models with systemic risk must engage in structured dialogue with the AI Office when initiated, providing information on internal testing, safeguards for preventing systemic risks, and other internal mitigation measures.
exceptions: Structured dialogue is initiated at the discretion of the AI Office prior to a formal access request
